findings.title: Module entitlements are derived but not enforced server-side
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: apps/api/src/middleware/entitlement.ts:142-171 requireEntitlement/requireActiveSubscription (402 PAYMENT_REQUIRED, 30s cache, admin bypass) and apps/api/src/lib/entitlements.ts:75-117 resolveOrgEntitlements; all six subscription-tier routers mount the gate: service-catalog.ts:17, findings.ts:36, governance.ts:34, security-ops.ts:24, qbr.ts:19, training-hub.ts:17. Module coverage is exactly the MODULE_REGISTRY subscription set (packages/sdk/src/module-registry.ts entitlement:"subscription" x6).

findings.title: `payments` table is never populated; payment history is silently empty
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: webhook lifecycle writes at apps/api/src/routes/webhooks.ts:492-542 (payment_intent.succeeded/payment_failed/canceled, linked via resolveBillingRefs:124-152) and sync backfill at apps/api/src/routes/billing.ts:572-625 (PaymentIntents -> payments, invoice linkage by stripe id); GET /billing/payments reads the table (billing.ts:345-372).

findings.title: Missing Stripe webhook events leave refunds, void, and payment lifecycle unrecorded
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: charge.refunded -> payments refund state (webhooks.ts:548-580), invoice.voided/marked_uncollectible -> status+voided_at (webhooks.ts:584-601), subscription.created/updated/deleted (webhooks.ts:403-466), invoice.paid/payment_failed with dunning (webhooks.ts:309-401). Sync also backfills refunds from charge.amount_refunded (billing.ts:627-649).

findings.title: No refund and incomplete trial/cancel state handling
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: schema columns added in supabase/migrations/5302444_billing_lifecycle_fields.sql (interval/trial_start/trial_end/cancel_at_period_end/canceled_at/quantity, voided_at, refund_amount_cents/refunded_at) and written by webhooks.ts:438-462/548-580 and billing.ts:545-568/632-649.

findings.title: `POST /billing/sync` does not paginate Stripe results
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: apps/api/src/routes/billing.ts:101-144 fetchStripePages follows starting_after with limit=100, a page cap (STRIPE_SYNC_MAX_PAGES), and returns truncated/error; billing.ts:490-507 fails the sync 502 STRIPE_SYNC_INCOMPLETE instead of reporting success for a partial mirror.

findings.title: Reconciliation job has no drift detection, alerting, or tests
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: apps/worker/src/tasks/stripe-reconcile.ts:142-264 detects subscription status, invoice count/sum and payment count/sum drift (recordStripeReconcileDrift) and 444-449 returns ok:false on any drift/error; alert infra/digitalocean/prometheus.rules.yml:350-368 (mct-billing-reconcile); tests apps/worker/src/__tests__/tasks/stripe-reconcile.test.ts.

findings.title: Failed payments produce no notification or dunning visibility
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: apps/api/src/lib/billing-dunning.ts resolves approved billing-role contacts and sends preference-aware in-app+email via notifyAndEmail; wired on invoice.payment_failed at webhooks.ts:388-397; metric portal_billing_dunning_notifications_total (metrics.ts:278-288); the portal shows overdue counts and per-invoice status incl. uncollectible (BillingPageClient.tsx:147-150, 296-306).

findings.title: Subscription/invoice schema lacks trial, interval, and void-lifecycle fields
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: migration 5302444 adds the lifecycle columns; both write paths persist them (webhooks.ts:438-462, billing.ts:545-568) and stripe-reconcile writes Stripe state back (stripe-reconcile.ts:369-397). docs/modules/billing.md:36,75-78 documents them.

findings.title: Stripe webhook DB writes ignore errors and still mark the event processed
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: every mirror write goes through assertMirrorWrite (webhooks.ts:207-218; used at :362,:462,:485,:538,:577,:599), the audit write failure throws (:603-613), the delivery-log insert failure throws (:72-90), and the outer catch releases the idempotency claim + records a failed delivery (:619-631).

findings.title: Out-of-order or late-retried Stripe events can overwrite terminal payment states
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: TERMINAL_PAYMENT/INVOICE/SUBSCRIPTION sets (webhooks.ts:174-176) + readMirrorStatus (:183-200) guard invoice.paid/payment_failed (:322-337), subscription events (:420-435), payment_intent events (:507-521) and stale partial refunds (:554-567); sync preserves terminal refund states (billing.ts:586-603).

findings.title: Billing read endpoints fall back to all-tenant scope for cross-tenant roles without an admin-scope guard or audit
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: every GET applies applyRequestedOrg+applyOrgScope (billing.ts:231-236,292-293,314-315,332-333,361-362,382-383) and the implicit all-tenant read is audited billing.cross_tenant_read (:157-178); scope semantics in apps/api/src/lib/admin-scope.ts:55-71 (super_admin AND cross-tenant role).

findings.title: Webhook raw body typed as `string` but consumed as `Buffer`
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: rawBodyBuffer(req.rawBody) rejects when the exact bytes were not captured (webhooks.ts:270-280) and stripe.webhooks.constructEvent consumes the Buffer; same helper for Jira/JSM (:659-671,:767-779).

findings.title: Billing email stored in plaintext and raw Stripe payment-method id rendered to users
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: checkout.session.completed encrypts billing_email with encryptField (webhooks.ts:468-486); reads decrypt and mask the pm id (billing.ts:199-222,390-398); the portal renders the decrypted email/masked method only (BillingPageClient.tsx:190-200).

findings.title: `invoice.paid` paid_at handling writes epoch dates (sync) or throws when status_transitions is missing (webhook)
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: apps/api/src/lib/billing-timestamps.ts invoicePaidAtIso falls back to created then now (never epoch) and is used by both paths (billing.ts:530, webhooks.ts:358); epochSecondsToIsoOrNow for payment paid_at.

findings.title: Payments list uses an inner join, hiding payments not linked to an invoice
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: billing.ts:355-360 selects invoices(invoice_number,status) without !inner, so unlinked payments list with a null invoice column.

findings.title: Entitlement override cannot revoke all modules (all-disabled falls back to the subscription set)
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: apps/api/src/lib/entitlements.ts:104-110 treats the mere existence of provisioned rows (even all-disabled) as the explicit override and returns the enabled subset, never the subscription set.

findings.title: Subscription mirror ignores seat quantity and the billing summary excludes trialing plans
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: quantity persisted (billing.ts:565, webhooks.ts:458, stripe-reconcile.ts:385); summary counts active+trialing (billing.ts:248-251); the portal renders unit x quantity and a seats suffix (BillingPageClient.tsx:84-95).

findings.title: Portal 'Sync from Stripe' button is shown to client roles that lack billing:manage
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: BillingPageClient.tsx:103-106 gates the button on can("billing","manage") and the API enforces requirePermission("billing","manage") (billing.ts:404).

findings.title: Billing docs contradict the implementation (sync gate, webhook verification, reconcile source, payment statuses)
findings.note: re-verified at 7dd0402: docs/BILLING.md:92,101-104,109,125,144-147 document the billing:manage sync gate, full signature verification, payments lifecycle incl. refunds, and the entitlement override semantics; docs/modules/billing.md:17,31-32,36,42,75-78,105 match the code.

findings.title: Entitlement enforcement fails open on billing-state lookup errors with no metric or alert
findings.note: NEW at 7dd0402: apps/api/src/middleware/entitlement.ts:12-24,88-94 deliberately allows the request when resolveOrgEntitlements throws; the failure is logged (logger.error) but no counter is emitted (no metric in apps/api/src/lib/metrics.ts) and no Prometheus rule matches it, so a sustained billing-state outage silently disables the plan gate for every gated module. Recommend an entitlement_resolution_failures_total counter + alert, and optionally a bounded fail-open (deny after N minutes of failures).
